project.description: New three-story building with ground floor retail and two dwelling units above. Zoning district B3-2. Standard Plan Review.
project.reviewer: Department of Buildings, first review cycle

comments.heading: General
comments.text: Exit signs in the retail space are not shown on the first floor plan.

comments.heading: Zoning
comments.text: The projecting sign extends over the sidewalk. A public way use permit from the Department of Transportation is needed.

comments.heading: Building
comments.text: Per 13-76, firestopping details for pipe penetrations through the rated floor are not included. Add them to the assembly details.

comments.heading: Structural
comments.text: Snow drift on the lower roof at the parapet is not addressed on the roof framing plan.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: The owner's estimated cost of work is blank on the application.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: The title block on E-101 carries an old project number. Correct the title block.

expected.why: Exit signs are part of the means of egress design.
The Department of Transportation issues this.
Title 13 was replaced. Penetration protection is fire-resistance design.
Snow drift design is the engineer's. Don't supply a load.
Only the owner knows the cost.
